{{Top|leg}}
A '''ven''' was a level within the [[Great Structure]], the central tenet in the [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar's]] [[Ulizra]] religion. There were fourteen vens, and study of each allowed a student to rise to the next one in the hierarchy.<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
